The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Oracle SQL/PLSQL, PostgreSQL, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns, with a focus on data integrity, fault tolerance, performance, and operational reliability. Key Responsibilities 1. Kafka Consumer Development Design and develop Java-based Kafka consumers using Spring Boot and Spring Kafka. Consume enterprise data events from Kafka topics hosted in AWS. Implement message parsing, schema validation, transformation, and business-rule validations. Persist consumed data into Oracle PaaS database tables. Implement reliable Kafka offset management to prevent message loss. Handle duplicate messages, retries, failed messages, and dead-letter topics. Support Kafka consumer group management, partitioning, and throughput optimization. Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for Kafka processing failures. 2. Oracle PaaS Data Persistence Develop Java services to insert, update, and merge Kafka-consumed data into Oracle PaaS databases. Design staging tables, integration tables, and audit/control tables. Implement transactional processing, data validation, and error handling. Optimize SQL queries and database operations for high-volume processing. Ensure data consistency and traceability between Kafka messages and Oracle records. Implement restartable and recoverable processing mechanisms. 3. Asynchronous Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Synchronization Design and develop asynchronous Java services to synchronize data from Oracle PaaS to PostgreSQL hosted in GCP. Implement reliable data synchronization using transactional outbox, change data capture (CDC), or controlled incremental processing patterns as appropriate. Ensure Oracle database transactions and synchronization events are consistently captured. Implement retry mechanisms, duplicate-safe processing, checkpoint management, and failure recovery. Maintain data consistency between Oracle PaaS and PostgreSQL. Develop reconciliation processes to identify missing, failed, or inconsistent records. Support replay and reprocessing of failed synchronization transactions. Monitor synchronization delays, processing status, and data completeness. 4. Flat File Generation and Enable SFTP Integration Develop Java-based batch services to extract and process data from PostgreSQL. Implement business rules for data filtering, transformation, aggregation, and mapping. Generate CSV, delimited, or other Enable-approved flat-file formats. Implement file naming conventions, header/trailer records, record counts, and control totals where required. Validate file structure, completeness, accuracy, and duplicate prevention. Implement secure SFTP file transmission to the Enable platform. Develop file transfer logging, delivery status tracking, retry, and recovery mechanisms. Implement file archiving, retention, and audit controls. Support reconciliation between source records, generated files, and vendor acknowledgments where available. Develop Java batch jobs that can be triggered and managed through UC4/Automic. 6. GCP Deployment and Application Support Develop containerized Java services for deployment on Google Cloud Platform. Work with cloud infrastructure teams to configure application environments, connectivity, and security. Support integration with GCP services such as Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and Cloud Logging. Implement secure connectivity between AWS Kafka, Oracle PaaS, PostgreSQL, and Enable SFTP. Support CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and production deployments. Troubleshoot performance, connectivity, and integration failures. 7. Testing and Quality Assurance Test Kafka message processing, database persistence, asynchronous synchronization, and file generation. Validate duplicate handling, retry processing, failure recovery, and data reconciliation. Support QA, SIT, E2E, and UAT testing. Document technical designs, interface mappings, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks. Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on development experience in Java, Spring Boot , Microservices Integration development usingREST APIs / JSON , Java Batch Processing Apache Kafka consumer development, offsets, retries Hands-on experience in SQL, JDBC, bulk processing in PostgreSQL Preferred Skills Experience deploying Java microservices on Google Cloud Platform. Experience consuming Kafka topics hosted in AWS from applications deployed in GCP. Knowledge of Oracle PaaS environments and connectivity. Experience with UC4/Automic scheduling and enterprise batch orchestration. Experience implementing financial data interfaces and reconciliation controls. Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud observability. Experience with SFTP. Understanding of SOX controls, audit trails, data retention, and financial data security. Key Competencies Strong understanding of distributed systems and enterprise integration architecture. Ability to design reliable, fault-tolerant, and recoverable data processing solutions. Strong analytical and SQL troubleshooting skills. Understanding of transaction management and eventual consistency. Ability to independently own integration components from development through production support. Strong collaboration with product, DBAs, QA, infrastructure, and business teams. title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
description:
Company Overview AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website 
 Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview 
 Job Role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce expert to help improve the quality and reliability of products built for complex Salesforce engineering environments. 
 The role combines platform engineering, technical investigation, scenario design, and product validation. You will recreate real-world development and release challenges, establish technically correct outcomes, identify edge cases, and work with Product and Engineering teams to improve product behaviour. 
 This role is suited to someone who understands how Salesforce behaves beyond the happy path. 
 Key Responsibilities Design realistic Salesforce development, configuration, and release scenarios. Establish expected outcomes and clear technical acceptance criteria. Validate product behavior across metadata, code, security, integrations, and deployment workflows. Investigate incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent results. Reproduce complex failures across orgs, sandboxes, API versions, and release configurations. Build reusable technical assets that improve product coverage and prevent regressions. Analyze dependencies, deployment sequencing, environment drift, and configuration differences. Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize platform gaps and improve reliability. Track Salesforce platform releases and assess their impact on supported workflows. Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls Pride of Ownership 
 We value pride of ownership. Understand the customer, the product and the market need; form a clear, evidence-based opinion about how the product can improve; and work with others to turn that opinion into results. Strong coding skills and effective use of AI matter, but accountability continues after a feature is shipped. Be willing to challenge assumptions, listen to feedback and change your view when the evidence changes. 
 Experience & Desired Skills 
 Required Skills (Mandatory) 58 years of hands-on Salesforce development or platform engineering experience. Strong experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, validation rules, and asynchronous processing. Deep understanding of Salesforce metadata, dependencies, deployment behavior, and org configuration. Strong knowledge of profiles, permission sets, sharing, roles, record types, and field-level security. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CLI, Metadata API, Tooling API, Apex testing, and deployment troubleshooting. Strong Git skills, including branching, pull requests, merge-conflict resolution, and release promotion. Experience working across multiple Salesforce orgs and sandbox strategies. Ability to explain technical decisions through precise reasoning and evidence. Strong written communication and attention to detail. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Experience with CI/CD platforms or Salesforce DevOps products. Experience diagnosing complex metadata, packaging, or environment-specific failures. Exposure to REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, Connected Apps, and Named Credentials. Experience with managed packages, unlocked packages, namespaces, or enterprise release processes. Experience defining technical test scenarios, review standards, or quality frameworks. Experience with one or more Salesforce industry or specialized clouds. Python or scripting experience is beneficial. Salesforce Platform Exposure 
 Strong Salesforce Core Platform expertise is required. 
 Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: Sales Cloud Service Cloud Experience Cloud Revenue Cloud or CPQ Field Service Data Cloud Financial Services Cloud Health Cloud Manufacturing Cloud Salesforce Industries Agentforce Depth in every cloud is not expected. We value candidates who understand how platform capabilities affect metadata, security, integrations, and releases. 
 Certification Salesforce Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, JavaScript Developer I, Application Architect, System Architect, or relevant DevOps certifications are preferred (not required) What is required is true experience in Salesforce development & implementations across verticals. What success looks like Complex Salesforce scenarios are represented accurately and reproducibly. Platform-specific gaps and failure modes are identified early. Technical outcomes are supported by clear evidence. Product coverage expands across meaningful Salesforce use cases. Discovered issues become durable regression protection. Product and Engineering teams can make faster decisions with greater confidence. Who Will Thrive Here 
 You will thrive in this role if you: Enjoy investigating why the same change behaves differently across environments. Naturally look for dependencies, edge cases, and hidden assumptions. Can distinguish a valid alternative from a technically incorrect result. Turn difficult incidents into repeatable technical scenarios. Prefer evidence over intuition. Communicate complex Salesforce behavior clearly and precisely. Why join AutoRABIT 
 Your Salesforce expertise will directly influence how our products behave. You will have the opportunity to turn domain knowledge into better customer workflows and help teams prevent failures before customers encounter them.

 Compensation: 24 - 30 Lakhs per annum  
 Location: Hyderabad 
 Work Mode: Hybrid - 3 days Work from Office 
 Work Timings : IST timings - General Flexible Shift

title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

Identify redundant, outdated, or unnecessarily complex dashboard components and recommend opportunities for simplification and consolidation. Advanced knowledge of Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server/Cloud. Strong experience with calculated fields, table calculations, Level of Detail (LOD) expressions, parameters, sets, filters, dashboard actions, and complex visualization techniques. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

Job Summary Synechron is seeking an experienced CyberArk Engineer with 4+ years of CyberArk administration and engineering experience to manage, enhance, and support the organizations Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The role will focus on CyberArk implementation, privileged account onboarding, enterprise integrations, automation, platform maintenance, and operational support. This position contributes to business objectives by protecting privileged accounts, strengthening access controls, supporting compliance requirements, and reducing risks associated with unauthorized or unmanaged privileged access. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required CyberArk Vault: Hands-on administration, configuration, support, and maintenance experience using the organizations supported version. Password Vault Web Access (PVWA): Experience managing administrative access, user workflows, account access, and platform operations. Central Policy Manager (CPM): Experience configuring password policies, account management, password rotation, and reconciliation. Privileged Session Manager (PSM): Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting privileged sessions. Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA): Experience supporting privileged access monitoring, analytics, alerts, and investigation activities. Active Directory and LDAP: Experience integrating CyberArk with directory services and enterprise identity platforms. Windows Server and Linux Administration: Experience onboarding and supporting privileged accounts across Windows, Linux, and Unix environments. PowerShell and Scripting: Experience developing scripts for automation, administration, validation, and operational support. REST APIs and CyberArk APIs: Experience using APIs to support integrations, automation, account management, or monitoring activities. IAM and Security Tools: Practical understanding of identity and access management technologies, privileged access controls, authentication, authorization, and security operations. Defect, Incident, and Change Management Tools: Experience using approved tools to document incidents, service requests, changes, investigations, and operational activities. Preferred CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): Experience with administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege controls, or support. Cloud Identity and Infrastructure Platforms: Experience integrating CyberArk with Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Automation Tools: Exposure to automation frameworks, infrastructure automation, configuration management, or deployment tools. CyberArk Defender Certification: Preferred. description:
Company Profile - 
 Healthedge is an agile and innovative 21st century software company focused on providing 
 next-generation, business-transforming technology products to the healthcare payer market. 
 We enable our customers to radically innovate, drastically reduce costs, and efficiently address 
 the business imperatives of the evolving healthcare economy. Healthedge is headquartered in 
 Burlington, MA (USA) with development offices in Hyderabad (India), Bangalore (India), Pune 
 (India) and Powell, OH (USA). 
 Healthedge has been listed as a sample vendor for Next-Generation Core Administrative 
 Systems in Gartners 2017 hype cycle for U.S. healthcare payers. 
 Additionally, Healthedge is a proud winner of 3 awards from Comparably : Best Company Work
 Life Balance, Happiest Employees of 2024, and Best Company Perks & Benefits! These awards only 
 reinforces what we’ve known all along: the best and brightest work at Healthedge. 
 Designation: Senior Software Engineer 
 Location: Hyderabad 
 About the Role : 
 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and scale next
 generation healthcare technology solutions that improve patient outcomes, streamline clinical 
 workflows, and drive operational efficiency across health systems. The ideal candidate will 
 bring deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem, a passion for engineering excellence, and a proven 
 track record of delivering high-impact, production-grade systems in complex, regulated 
 domains. 
 This role sits at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation — offering the 
 opportunity to architect and shape products that serve millions of patients and truly make a 
 difference. If you thrive on solving hard problems at scale, care deeply about code quality and 
 system resilience, and want your engineering work to have real-world impact beyond business 
 metrics — we'd love to hear from you. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design, develop, and deliver production-grade software as per defined requirements 
 and technical specifications, ensuring adherence to healthcare domain standards and 
 compliance frameworks. 
 • Build and maintain user interfaces, databases, APIs, and client-facing displays across our 
 healthcare platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end user experiences for our end users. 
 • Initiate and drive technical design — architect complex application features, evaluate 
 design trade-offs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term 
 system maintainability. 
 • Produce well-organized, optimized, and thoroughly documented source code in line 
 with established coding guidelines and best practices, maintaining a high bar for 
 readability and consistency. 
 • Debug, troubleshoot, and refine existing source code — identify root causes efficiently, 
 polish feature sets, and improve system performance and reliability with every release 
 cycle. 
 • Contribute to technical design documentation — author and maintain architecture 
 decision records (ADRs), design specs, and runbooks that enable the team to move fast 
 without breaking things. 
 • Build and execute comprehensive unit and integration test cases to ensure code quality, 
 reduce regression risk, and maintain confidence in every deployment. 
 • Test features in controlled, real-world scenarios before go-live — participate in staging 
 validations, UAT coordination, and production rollout monitoring to ensure zero
 disruption releases. 
 • Innovate and develop high-value technology solutions that streamline clinical 
 workflows, reduce manual overhead, and unlock new capabilities for healthcare 
 providers and patients. 
 • Coordinate with fellow engineers and cross-functional teams — collaborate closely with 
 product managers, clinicians, QA, DevOps, data science, and compliance teams to 
 deliver cohesive, high-quality solutions. 
 • Work independently when required — take ownership of ambiguous problems, drive 
 them to resolution with minimal handholding, and communicate progress proactively 
 to stakeholders. 
 • Maintain meticulous attention to detail — every task, from code reviews to 
 documentation to production deployments, must be carried out to the highest standard 
 of quality and precision. 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. 
 • 5+ years of total software development experience. 
 • Proven experience building and delivering complex, scalable software systems — 
 preferably in the healthcare domain. 
 • Strong programming expertise in C# and the .NET framework. 
 • Working experience in MVC architecture is a must. 
 • Hands on experience with Design patterns and Entity frameworks is a must. 
 • Strong hands-on experience with Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or 
 MySQL), Expert-level knowledge of SQL queries including stored procedures, functions 
 and views. 
 • Experience with UI frameworks such as Angular or React (added advantage). Working 
 experience on client-side technologies such as JavaScript, jQuery is required. 
 • Demonstrated proficiency in automation testing and adherence to Test-Driven 
 Development (TDD) principles. 
 • Solid experience in CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, with exposure to 
 automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 • Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure or AWS) and containerization (Docker, 
 Kubernetes) is preferred. 
 • Ability to work independently and in small teams, adaptability to a fast-paced 
 environment and a keen interest in staying current with the latest trends. 
 • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. 
 Why Join Us: 
 • Be part of a mission-driven organization revolutionizing healthcare delivery through 
 technology. 
 • Collaborate with product, clinical, and data teams solving real-world healthcare 
 challenges. 
 • Work with a technically strong team that values innovation, integrity, and impact. 
 • Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and significant career growth 
 opportunities.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Position Summary This is a role for someone early in their career who wants both hands-on IT and real software/infrastructure engineering experience. As part of a small, high-trust local team, you'll be the go-to person in the Lisbon office for day-to-day IT support - onboarding new hires, setting up hardware, keeping meeting rooms and workstations running - while also picking up real engineering work: automation scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS infrastructure support alongside a distributed engineering team. You'll learn fast, work directly with senior engineers, and grow from executing well-defined tasks into owning small pieces of infrastructure independently. The Role at a Glance Be the local IT point of contact for the Lisbon office - onboarding, hardware, and everyday support. Learn and apply core SRE practices - scripting, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure - under the guidance of senior engineers. Split your time between hands-on specialist work and hands-on engineering work; grow into more of the latter over time. Build a foundation in Linux, AWS, and automation that sets up a long-term engineering career path. What You'll Do & the Impact You'll Own Measured by growth and reliability, not tenure - within 6-12 months Own IT specialist duties for the Lisbon office: Handle new-hire onboarding end to end - hardware provisioning, account setup, workstation configuration, and welcome/orientation support - so new colleagues are productive from day one. Keep the local office running: Support workstations, conference rooms, and A/V equipment; manage local IT inventory and procurement; act as the first point of contact when something in the office isn't working. Provide day-to-day technical support: Troubleshoot common issues - login problems, device setup, network connectivity, basic Linux/Windows/macOS issues - and know when to escalate to the broader distributed team. Learn and contribute to automation: Write and maintain simple scripts and Ansible playbooks under guidance to reduce repetitive manual work; progressively take on larger pieces of automation as your skills grow. Support CI/CD and cloud infrastructure: Get hands-on with GitLab pipelines and AWS building blocks (IAM, EC2, basic networking) by shadowing and then assisting senior engineers on real infrastructure tasks. Build strong fundamentals: Develop working knowledge of Linux systems administration, version control, and cloud basics through real tickets and projects, not just documentation. Document and communicate clearly: Keep clear records of issues and fixes so recurring problems get solved once, not repeatedly; communicate status and blockers proactively to the wider (mostly remote) team. What You'll Need Experience: 0-2 years in an IT support, systems administration, or junior engineering role (internships and academic projects count). Linux fundamentals: Comfortable in a Linux/Unix environment - command line, file permissions, basic networking, and troubleshooting common issues. Scripting: Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) and eagerness to write more of it. IT support mindset: Comfortable being hands-on with hardware and being the local face of IT - patient, clear communicator, good with people who arent technical. Cloud curiosity: Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) and genuine interest in learning infrastructure and automation - formal production experience not required. Ownership and reliability: Able to work independently as the only (or one of very few) on-site technical resource, while staying closely connected to a distributed, remote-first team. Language: Fluent English (written and spoken); Portuguese is a plus for local vendor and office coordination. Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Nice to Have Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar). Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS (Cloud Practitioner or higher). Prior experience in a hardware/device support or IT helpdesk role.

Our Hyderabad studio is one of EA Mobile s largest development centers, bringing together teams across game design, engineering, art, experience design, production, analytics, quality, and live services. Alchemy - Bringing creativity, curiosity, and new ideas to everything you do. Role Overview We re looking for a Game Design Intern who is curious about how games work and excited to learn how great player experiences are designed, built, tested, and improved. As part of a game team, you will work alongside experienced designers and collaborate with disciplines such as engineering, art, experience design, product, analytics, and QA. You ll contribute to real game features and content while developing your skills across systems design, content design, balancing, prototyping, live services, and player-focused problem solving. You ll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment with ideas, learn from feedback, and take ownership of well-scoped design tasks. What You ll Do Support the design of game features, systems, content, and live-service experiences . Turn design ideas into clear flows, rules, requirements, and design documentation. Participate in brainstorming and design discussions , contributing ideas for new mechanics, features, events, and player experiences. Playtest features and content, identify design problems, gather feedback, and iterate on solutions. Work with designers, engineers, artists, experience designers, product managers, analysts, and QA to take ideas from concept toward implementation. Use player feedback, game data, and design principles to understand how features can be improved. Support balancing gameplay, progression, rewards, difficulty, and other game systems. Research games and competitors to understand design patterns, player motivations, market trends, and opportunities for innovation. Contribute to live-service content such as events, challenges, progression experiences, or other recurring player activities. Explore how emerging tools, including AI-assisted workflows , can help improve ideation, research, prototyping, documentation, and iteration. What You Bring A foundational understanding of game design principles , including gameplay loops, player motivation, progression, balance, feedback, challenge, and reward. Strong interest in building games and understanding why players find experiences engaging and fun . Creative and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate ideas clearly through written documentation, diagrams, presentations, or prototypes. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback and iteration. Ability to collaborate effectively with people from different disciplines. Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Game Design, Game Development, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or a related discipline , or able to demonstrate equivalent skills through personal or academic projects. A portfolio, playable project, prototype, game jam project, level, system design, or other game-design work that demonstrates your thinking and interest in game development. Experience designing levels, game systems, economies, progression, quests, events, or other game content. A broad interest in different game genres and a habit of breaking down and analyzing the games you play.
